speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether ECDA will introduce policy measures to increase transparency about preschools with safety violations and enforcement actions taken; (b) whether parents can access information about preschools' safety records and ECDA's regulatory actions; and (c) what safeguards exist to ensure parents are informed when serious safety violations occur at their children's preschools.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We recognise that parents are concerned about their children's well-being and safety in preschools.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The licence tenure serves as an indication of a centre's quality and performance.

speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik (Sengkang)
text: With reference to the 2023 molestation case involving the three victims, ages one to two years old, that are under a gag order imposed by the Courts, I have two supplementary questions.

speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik (Sengkang)
text: The first question: were the parents of the other unaffected children informed of the safety violations?

speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik (Sengkang)
text: Question two: while ECDA and the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) have restricted new enrolment into the preschool, were parents of these new children informed of the recent safety violations?

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: I think how ECDA responds to every incident will depend on the context, and what the Court rules and decides on.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: I want to reiterate the fact that, especially for parents who are concerned about safety, we do note the importance, and that all parents want a safe, nurturing and conducive environment for all our children to grow up in.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: We regulate the sector through the Early Childhood Development Centres Act.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: We have a Code of Practice, which is regularly updated and stipulates the minimum licensing requirements, regulatory requirements to ensure safety and well-being of our children.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: We cover aspects from safety to health, to nutrition, hygiene, curriculum, incident management, staff deployment, even administrative processes.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: A most recent addition was the requirement for closed-circuit television to be installed in the centres.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: I think these are done in consultation with the industry, as well as taking into consideration international best practices.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: These are what we do to ensure that we have a tight regime and control, to ensure safety in all our preschools.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: We also come together regularly as a sector to share best practices and also take feedback from all our operators.
